name: exceptionCopy
description: Returns a copy of a caught exception as a struct, with keys such as `message`, `detail`, `type`, `stackTrace` and `tagContext`. The copy is a separate object from the exception.

params.name: exception
params.description: A caught exception, such as the variable in a `catch` block.

coldfusion.notes: Listed by getFunctionList() in ColdFusion 2021+. No official documentation exists. Signature and behavior confirmed on CF2021 and CF2025.

examples.title: Copy a caught exception
